How to Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to apply for Amritsar District Court Counsellor Recruitment 2026 through offline mode should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before applying. Download the application form from the official website: https://amritsar.dcourts.gov.in/notice-category/recruitments. Fill the application form carefully with correct information. Attach self-attested copies of required documents such as photograph, signature, ID proof, and certificates. Check all details carefully before submission. Send the completed application form to the address mentioned in the notification through Speed Post / Registered Post or as instructed. Ensure the application reaches before the last date: 14-09-2026. Keep a photocopy of the submitted application form for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the Amritsar District Court Counsellor recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the application for the Counsellor posts is 14th September 2026. Ensure your application reaches the concerned authority before this deadline.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the Counsellor post?
faq.answer: Candidates must hold a Graduate degree from a recognized university, preferably with Social Science, Sociology, Psychology, Clinical Psychiatry, or Law as a subject. Additionally, at least two years of experience in social work or welfare is necessary.

faq.question: Q3. What is the maximum age limit for the Counsellor position?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for the Counsellor post is 35 years as of 01 January 2026.

faq.question: Q4. How many vacancies are available for the Counsellor post?
faq.answer: There are a total of 3 vacancies for the Counsellor position in the Amritsar District Court.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary structure for the Counsellor post?
faq.answer: The salary for the Counsellor post is Rs. 600 per sitting (maximum 5 sittings) or Rs. 7000 per reconciled case.

faq.question: Q6. What is the application mode for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The application mode for this recruitment is offline. Candidates need to send their application form to the official address mentioned in the notification.

faq.question: Q7. Is there any application fee for the Amritsar District Court Counsellor recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) in the official notification.

faq.question: Q8. What are the selection criteria for the Counsellor posts?
faq.answer: The selection process for the Counsellor posts will involve an Interview and Document Verification.

faq.question: Q9. Where can I find the official notification and application form?
faq.answer: The official notification and application form can be downloaded from the official website of the Amritsar District Court, the link for which is provided in the 'Important Links' section of this article.

faq.question: Q10. What kind of experience is required for the Counsellor role?
faq.answer: At least two years of experience is required in the field of social work/welfare, or associated with field work, research, or teaching in government departments, colleges, universities, or similar academic institutes in areas related to family welfare or problems of women and children.
